channel.title: Orchard
channel.description: Apple news, rumors and iPhone Duo apps, each with its source. An independent site, not affiliated with Apple.

item.title: Apple marks 20 years of (RED) with a talk at Apple SoHo on 1 December
item.description: Apple has listed a free Today at Apple session, 'Spotlight: (RED) on World AIDS Day', at its SoHo store in New York on Tuesday 1 December, 12:00 to 12:45 p.m. Apple senior director Alisha Johnson Wilder will talk with (RED) managing director Kate Charles, (RED) advisory board member Iman and Apple…

item.title: iPhone 18e may get a square camera bump like the iPad Pro
item.description: Engadget says CAD files from a supply chain source show the iPhone 18e with a raised, nearly square camera housing of about 28 by 35 mm. It would hold the single rear camera, the flash and the microphone, much like the M5 iPad Pro. The source is said to have been right about earlier iPhone…

item.title: iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 may have slightly thicker camera bumps
item.description: The same Engadget CAD files show the camera plateau on both the iPhone Air 2 and the iPhone 18 growing from 3.45 mm to 3.8 mm. The Air 2 would have two cameras side by side while the body stays 5.6 mm thick, matching dummy models seen the week before. The iPhone 18 would otherwise look like the…

item.title: EU says it is talking to Apple about rival browser engines on iPhone
item.description: A European Commission spokesperson told POLITICO that the Commission is in dialogue with Apple and is consulting the businesses behind this week's open letter on how rival browsers can compete with Safari. It calls browser competition a priority under the Digital Markets Act. Apple says its rules…

item.title: Walmart's app and website drop Apple Pay weeks after adding it
item.description: Walmart added Apple Pay to its iPhone app and US website only weeks ago, but the option has now gone, as Appleosophy first noticed and MacRumors confirmed. Some shoppers may still see it, so Walmart could be testing. Neither company has explained the change. Apple Pay still works at checkout in…

item.title: Red HomePod mini 2 and AirPods Max 2 may arrive for World AIDS Day
item.description: Mark Gurman (Bloomberg) says Apple plans (PRODUCT)RED editions of the HomePod mini 2 and AirPods Max 2 to raise money for the Global Fund, possibly on World AIDS Day, 1 December. The HomePod mini 2 would have red mesh; the AirPods Max 2 would be silver with white cushions and a red Digital Crown.…

item.title: Samsung may stay the only maker of iPhone Duo screens for five years
item.description: The Weibo leaker Instant Digital says Samsung Display could remain Apple's only supplier of foldable iPhone panels for at least five more years. The leaker says Samsung's lead in hiding the crease, reliability and factory yields makes it hard for LG Display to join. The same source earlier claimed…

item.title: Rebuilt Apple The Oracle store in Reading opens 3 December
item.description: Apple says its new Apple The Oracle store in Reading, England, opens on 3 December. The old store at the same shopping centre closes on 1 December. Apple has not shared details of the new design.

item.title: Connecticut IDs in Apple Wallet are coming next year
item.description: Connecticut launched its own mobile ID app last week, and its app maker IDEMIA says Apple Wallet support is coming soon. The state has said it aims to support Apple, Google and Samsung wallets by August 2027. Apple first named Connecticut as a Wallet ID state in 2021.

item.title: Mozilla, Shopify and others ask the EU to act on Apple's browser engine rules
item.description: An open letter organised by Open Web Advocacy, signed by Mozilla, Shopify, Vivaldi, Vercel and groups said to represent up to 55,000 EU businesses, asks the European Commission to open formal proceedings against Apple. They say no browser has moved its EU iPhone users off WebKit since Apple began…

item.title: iPhone Duo Lock Screen could get a second column of widgets
item.description: The leaker pdfu says Apple has tested a 'Complication Column' for the iPhone Duo Lock Screen: two round widgets stacked on the right edge, above the flashlight and camera buttons, used alongside the usual widget row. The code first appeared in iOS 27.1 but is switched off, and nothing has changed…

item.title: Gurman: Siri job cuts hit old systems, not the new AI work
item.description: Mark Gurman says Apple's recent Siri layoffs were aimed at staff on the assistant's older infrastructure, not its newer AI systems. He says Siri is still slow, works with few third-party apps and has worse dictation, and that Apple's yearly software plans, fixed well in advance, make it hard to…

item.title: Gurman: iPhone 18, 18e, new iPad, MacBook Neo and M6 MacBook Air around February or March
item.description: Mark Gurman says Apple plans its first launches of 2027 around February or March, during the iOS and macOS 27.4 cycle. The list: iPhone 18 and 18e with the A20 chip and 9GB of memory, an entry-level iPad with the A19 chip, Apple Intelligence and Wi-Fi 7, a MacBook Neo with the A19 Pro and 12GB of…

item.title: Apple closes its Basingstoke store in England
item.description: Apple Festival Place in Basingstoke shut for good on 21 November after more than 15 years. Apple gave no reason. Staff can move to Apple The Oracle in nearby Reading, which reopens as an upgraded store in December, or to other UK stores.

item.title: Siri AI delay settlement: claims close 21 December
item.description: Apple agreed to pay $250 million to settle a US class action over the delayed personal Siri, while denying wrongdoing. US buyers of an iPhone 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max or any iPhone 16 model bought between 10 June 2024 and 29 March 2025 can claim at smartphoneaisettlement.com until 21 December 2026.…

item.title: Apple job listing reveals work on an AI agent that can use a computer
item.description: Apple posted, then pulled, a listing for a senior engineering manager to lead its agent platform. It described an AI agent that uses a computer like a capable person: browsing the web, working across apps, running commands, writing code and handing steps to smaller sub-agents. The team would work…

item.title: Siri Recap hands-on: private, but not very useful
item.description: MacRumors tried Siri Recap, the watchOS 27.3 beta feature that listens to conversations on Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 and writes a short summary, discarding the audio. It caught dates, bill totals and medicine names well, and you can limit it to certain times and places. But summaries were…

item.title: Dummy models show iPhone Air 2 with two cameras
item.description: Leaker Sonny Dickson shared dummy models of the iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18. The Air 2 gets a second rear camera, with both lenses side by side in a wide camera bar. The iPhone 18 keeps two stacked lenses in a pill-shaped bump and looks much like the iPhone 17. Dummies are built from leaked…

item.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iPhone to keep Siri AI out
item.description: Signal's latest iPhone update adds a 'Block Siri AI' privacy switch, on by default, that stops screenshots in the app. Signal told Reuters that Apple does not give developers good tools to shield app content from Siri AI and other AI agents. You can turn the switch off. The Mac app has no such…

item.title: Car Keys in Wallet reach more Cadillac, Chevrolet and GMC models in December
item.description: General Motors says nine models will support car keys in Apple Wallet by the end of the year, with the wider rollout in December. They are the Cadillac Vistiq, Optiq, Lyriq, Escalade and Escalade IQ/IQL, the Chevrolet Suburban and Tahoe, and the GMC Yukon and Yukon XL, mostly 2026 and 2027 model…

item.title: UK tribunal says the government must confirm its secret order to Apple
item.description: The Investigatory Powers Tribunal ruled on 19 November that the UK government has to confirm it sent Apple a secret technical capability notice. The order, first reported by The Washington Post in early 2025, was said to seek access to iCloud data from users worldwide. Apple refused to build a…

item.title: Second public betas of iOS 27.3 and the other 27.3 updates are out
item.description: On 19 November Apple released second public betas of iOS, iPadOS, macOS Golden Gate, tvOS and watchOS 27.3, along with revised developer betas of iOS and iPadOS 27.3. Public testers now get front-camera unlock and Reachability on iPhone Duo, vertical tabs in Safari, the redesigned Health app and…

item.title: Apple may delay or drop the OLED iMac
item.description: The Elec, citing industry sources, says Apple is talking to Samsung Display about delaying its OLED iMac, and the project could be shelved. Reasons given: OLED panels are costly for a low-volume Mac, memory prices are rising, and OLED iPad Pro sales were weaker than hoped. Apple has also…

item.title: Apple names 45 finalists for the 2026 App Store Awards
item.description: Apple picked 45 finalists across 13 categories, including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro, Apple Watch and Apple TV apps and games, plus Cultural Impact. iPhone App finalists are ElevenReader, (Not Boring) Camera and Raylie; iPhone Game finalists are BALL x PIT, DAVE THE DIVER and Gambonanza.…

item.title: HomeView 27.2.1 fixes Siri bugs, but not alarms and timers
item.description: Apple's first HomeView update, out on 18 November, fixes Siri requests failing when paired with an iPhone or iPad on the 27.3 betas, Siri support not downloading after setting up a Shared Album on the Photos face, and HomeView dropping out of your home when another home hub is added. It does not…

item.title: iPhone 20 Pro may go back to titanium
item.description: Leaker Fixed Focus Digital says early iPhone 20 Pro prototypes use a titanium frame with a much more rounded design than the iPhone Air. Apple moved Pro models to aluminum with the iPhone 17 Pro; iPhone Air and iPhone Duo still use titanium. Prototype materials do not always reach the final…

item.title: iPhone Duo 2 may keep Touch ID and the same screen sizes
item.description: Leaker Digital Chat Station says iPhone Duo 2 engineering units have the same 7.6-inch inner and 5.4-inch outer screens and a side Touch ID button, with no clear sign of Face ID. The leaker doubts Face ID makes sense if it only works on the outer screen. This fits Mark Gurman's report that Face ID…

item.title: Hacked web tool turned big-name websites against iPhone visitors
item.description: On 16 November attackers abused a flaw in Optimizely, a website testing service, to slip malicious JavaScript onto sites run by 178 organizations, Reuters reported, including the BBC, CNN, HSBC, IKEA, Salesforce and Zoom. Security researcher Scott Helme found the code tried to swap crypto wallet…

item.title: iFixit teardown: HomeView is needlessly hard to repair
item.description: iFixit found strong glue holding the display, speakers and logic board, and one speaker snapped while being removed. The logic board is bonded to the aluminum shell, which works as a heat sink, so it took real force to free. The tabletop and wall-mounted models are built differently inside and…

item.title: App Store prices change in five countries, and California adds tax on some apps
item.description: Apple told developers that new taxes now apply in Botswana (14% VAT), Rwanda (18% VAT), Cameroon and Côte d'Ivoire (3% digital tax each). On 3 December App Store prices will be adjusted in Botswana, Colombia, Egypt, Rwanda and Türkiye; auto-renewing subscriptions and manually set prices are not…

item.title: Final Cut Pro gets MotionVFX effects for Creator Studio subscribers
item.description: Apple is updating Final Cut Pro with the templates, titles, transitions and effects from MotionVFX, a company it bought earlier this year. The update adds 3D titles that follow camera movement, better masking, a way to animate still images, a Content Hub with stock media, text-to-image generation…

item.title: iOS 27.3's new Health app needs an iPhone 15 Pro or later
item.description: The redesigned Health app in iOS 27.3 relies on Apple Intelligence, so 9to5Mac reports it needs an iPhone 15 Pro or newer with Apple Intelligence turned on. On older iPhones the Health app will look mostly the same. The new features also start in only some languages. iOS 27.3 is expected next month.

item.title: UK iCloud+ plans won't raise Siri AI limits
item.description: Apple's support page on the new daily limits for Siri AI and other server-based Apple Intelligence features says most iCloud+ plans raise those limits at no extra cost, but not in the UK. It is not yet clear whether UK users will have another way to get more use. The limits start with iOS 27.3.

item.title: Epic says Apple is holding back 122,000 documents on its fee plans
item.description: In the US District Court case over App Store link-outs, Epic told the court that Apple produced 632 documents matching agreed search terms but withheld more than 122,000 others as not relevant. Epic wants all non-privileged matches handed over by 2 December, with a daily fine for each day after…

item.title: Morgan Stanley expects iPhone to gain share in a shrinking 2027 market
item.description: A Morgan Stanley report forecasts about 270 million iPhone shipments in 2027, up 7%, while overall smartphone shipments fall 5%. That would give Apple about 26% of the market. The bank notes some of the gain may simply be sales moving into 2027, since the iPhone 18 and 18e are expected in spring.…

item.title: Apple Account sign-in, App Store and Apple Store systems go down
item.description: On the morning of 17 November many Apple services stopped working. People could not sign in to their Apple Account, were signed out of iCloud, or could not download apps. Apple Music, Apple Pay, iPhone activation and App Store Connect were also hit, and Apple's own retail stores could not complete…

item.title: Apple now sells iPhone Duo repair parts for DIY fixes
item.description: iPhone Duo parts and tools are now on Apple's Self Service Repair Store in the US, Canada and Europe. The parts list covers both displays, both batteries, the back glass, cameras, speakers, the logic board, the Touch ID and Camera Control part, the USB-C port and more. Tools such as suction cups,…

item.title: Apple Store app is now optimized for iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple's own shopping app has been updated for iPhone Duo. It now fills both the inner and outer screens in any orientation, moves to a single tab bar at the bottom, and has a slightly refreshed icon. It had been one of the few Apple apps still missing Duo support.

item.title: Report: Apple pushed an iPhone Duo supplier to pull its statement on screen cracks
item.description: Korea's The Elec says Apple pressured Fine M-Tec, which reportedly makes the metal plates that support the Duo's folding screen, to take down a statement. On 26 October the company had said the screen problems were not caused by its parts; the statement was gone from its website by 4 November. A…

item.title: Apple starts work on better dual SIM support for apps in the EU
item.description: Apple has moved a developer's EU interoperability request into its build phase. The request asks that calling and contacts apps be able to read the names you give your lines (such as Work and Personal), read and set the preferred line for each contact, and show which line a call used. It does not…
